description: Reusable form type definitions for the Division of Continuity Management. The game engine reads form_types to apply visual styling and default behaviours; individual cases still define all their own fields.

R-19.name: Recreational Reallocation Request
R-19.description: For the assessment and reclassification of non-productive recreational activities and their symbolic value to the Continuum.
R-19.notes: Low-stakes entry point. Establishes tone of bureaucratic care over personal habits.

R-19b.name: Ripple Reassessment
R-19b.description: Follow-up form for reassessing the downstream effects of a previous R-19 filing.
R-19b.notes: Return-case form. Always linked to a prior R-19 completion flag.

G-7.name: Grief Commercialization Assessment
G-7.description: For the evaluation and routing of inherited or personal grief to productive channels. Grief is a resource. It must be filed correctly.
G-7.notes: High emotional weight. System Voice should feel warmer than standard. Handle memory reclassification with care.

D-14.name: Developmental Compression Audit
D-14.description: For the review and reclassification of developmental anomalies, magical thinking residue, and pre-rational childhood experiences.
D-14.notes: Triggers childhood_policy flag. Has generational ripple potential. Most emotionally confronting for players who reflect.

DN-22.name: Dyadic Narrative Alignment
DN-22.description: For the assessment and alignment of two-person relational narratives that have begun to diverge from approved continuity.
DN-22.notes: Introduces the question of whose story matters more. Priority weighting sets langford flags used in Day 2.

DN-22b.name: Advanced Dyadic Maintenance
DN-22b.description: Return-case form for dyadic units showing post-alignment complications. Includes Mercy Override field at Clearance 2.
DN-22b.notes: Mercy Override is the first instance where the player can directly insert themselves into another person's story. High dissolution cost.

Θ-SR1.name: Self-Referential Audit — Level 1
Θ-SR1.description: For the processing of files that reference the Processor's own Continuity data. Clearance warning required.
Θ-SR1.notes: First introduction of the Echo mechanic. Sets echo_awareness flag. System Voice should be slightly warmer and more intimate than standard.

Θ-SR2.name: Self-Referential Audit — Level 2
Θ-SR2.description: Advanced self-referential processing for files with metadata dated in the future. Level 2 required.
Θ-SR2.notes: Day 2 climax case. All four options have major narrative consequences. Swap Places option is highest-risk available in the game at this point.

Θ-SR3.name: Temporal Self-Audit — Level 3
Θ-SR3.description: For the processing of a temporally-displaced projection of the Processor's own file. Level 3 required. Please be seated.
Θ-SR3.notes: Day 3 climax. Final major decision before ending calculation. The System Voice must be at its most intimate here.

M-11.name: Mythic Commodities Harvesting
M-11.description: For the extraction, routing, and monetization of high-yield mythic surplus from creative practitioners.
M-11.notes: Symbol insertion field only available at Clearance 2. The train/spiral/mandala options cross-reference other cases.

M-11b.name: Visionary Containment
M-11b.description: Return-case form for creative practitioners who have escalated beyond standard mythic commodity management.
M-11b.notes: The painting_action section is unique to Day 3. Step Into Painting triggers the painted_echo flag and has major cosmological implications.

P-33.name: Generational Thread Alignment
P-33.description: For the assessment and realignment of intergenerational narrative threads, particularly where childhood reclassification has produced offspring-level instability.
P-33.notes: Sets theo_partial_restoration flag if mercy option chosen. This flag is checked in EndingEvaluator for the quiet_rebellion path.

P-33b.name: Multi-Generational Realignment
P-33b.description: Expanded generational processing for family units exhibiting recursive wonder feedback loops.
P-33b.notes: ancestral_processor flag is among the strongest narrative-bond flags in the game. Creates persistent cross-case references.

DM-4.name: Oneiric Stabilization
DM-4.description: For the processing and stabilization of collective dream content in affected population sectors.
DM-4.notes: Self-insertion option is the most dissolution-costly single action available before Day 3 finale cases. Sets self_inserted_dreams flag.

IA-9.name: Mentorship Audit
IA-9.description: For the formal evaluation of inter-processor mentorship engagements and their systemic effects.
IA-9.notes: burden_carried flag used in EndingEvaluator for merciful_erasure path. The junior_doubt_encouraged flag is checked for system_fracture path.

choice.description: Select one option from a set of classified alternatives. Each option carries effects and ripples.
choice.rendering_notes: Display as mutually-exclusive button group. Selected option highlighted in amber. Sublabel rendered in smaller grey text below main label.

slider.description: Calibrate a continuous value within an approved range. Interpolates between min and max effects.
slider.rendering_notes: Displays current numeric value to the right. Default value pulled from 'default' field. effects_at_min and effects_at_max are linearly interpolated.

text.description: Provide a written reclassification, re-narration, or symbol insertion. Freeform field.
text.rendering_notes: Multi-line text area. Placeholder text from 'placeholder' field. No mechanical effect unless effects_if_filled is defined.

toggle.description: Binary approval or override. On/off with separate effect sets.
toggle.rendering_notes: Toggle button. effects_on applied when true, effects_off when false. ripples_on queued when toggled on.

dissolution_index.description: Player's personal dissolution. Primary axis of transformation.

efficiency_score.description: Player's daily processing efficiency. Required above 60 for promotion.

continuity_contribution.description: MEV accumulated for the Division. Higher = more promotable.

clearance_level.description: Access tier. Increases unlock form fields and case types.

mythic_residue.description: Accumulated archetypal weight. Drives Mythic Ascension ending.

narrative_stability.description: Coherence of the player's personal story. Below 30 causes visual glitch FX.

emotional_surplus.description: Excess/deficit of processed emotion. Drives quiet_rebellion and merciful_erasure paths.

reality_stability.description: World state. Below 15 triggers the_unraveling ending override.

unraveling_events.description: Count of major destabilizing events. Contributes to the_unraveling check.

mythic_commodities_index.description: Economic index of mythic output. Drives market scenes and certain ripple texts.

collective_nostalgia.description: Sector-level nostalgia saturation. High values make certain cases more palatable.
